status: Linux server edition preview. Mac and Windows remain at 0.11.0; Android and Android TV clients at 0.11.1.

checks.installedPackage: Ubuntu 24.04 (GitHub-hosted runner) with a real systemd user session and Xvfb: 17 installed-package checks passed, from deb install through upgrade and removal.
checks.headless: Fedora 41 and Debian 12 containers without systemd or a display: rpm/deb install, server setup, ready status, stop and quit as an unprivileged user.

limitations: Tested on Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and Fedora 41. Other distributions are expected to work but were not tested.
Hosted Ubuntu runner under Xvfb; physical GPUs (VA-API, NVENC, Quick Sync) were not qualified.
No public Cloudflare tunnel was configured during verification.
x86_64 only in this release; arm64 runtimes are pinned but no arm64 package is published.
Packages are unsigned; verify the SHA-256 before installing.
